rationale: The current best line wins with reverse-order two-block tail recurrence, but those gates start at zero so the reused tail depth has to be learned from scratch inside a 600s run. I warm-start the recurrent gates with a small depth ramp so the deepest repeated block is active immediately and the shallower repeated block starts weaker. This keeps shapes, traversal, quant-aware training, and the int8 export path unchanged while biasing capacity toward the proven recurrent-tail path.
title: Warm-Start Reverse Tail Recurrence Gates
